items.heading: Calulu de Peixe
details: Key ingredients: fish, eggplant, okra, palm oil
Simmer dried and fresh fish together with palm oil.
Add eggplant and okra, cooking until soft.
Season well and simmer until the sauce thickens.
Serve hot with rice or fried banana.

items.heading: Feijoada Santomense
details: Key ingredients: beans, smoked meat, vegetables
Soak and simmer beans with smoked meat until tender.
Add root vegetables and greens.
Cook until everything is soft and well combined.
Serve the hearty stew over rice.
